headline: A heavy week for AI tooling CVEs, plus practical wins in detection: GuardDuty by organization policy and grouped remediation in Security Hub.

highlights.why_it_matters: Remediation plans group exposure findings by root cause, so one fix can close several exposures. Each plan comes with step-by-step guidance in CLI, Terraform, CloudFormation and CDK.
highlights.action: Use the critical and high plans as next sprint's backlog and keep the fixes in IaC.

highlights.why_it_matters: GuardDuty can now be enabled through an AWS Organizations declarative policy, which covers existing accounts and every new one without custom automation.
highlights.action: Replace enablement scripts with the declarative policy and check coverage per account and Region.

highlights.why_it_matters: Runtime Monitoring is now part of the Security Hub Threat Analytics plan, with no separate GuardDuty charge where Security Hub is on.
highlights.action: Review runtime coverage for EC2, EKS and Fargate and remove duplicate billing.

highlights.why_it_matters: AWS Continuum can run penetration tests inside CI/CD pipelines (public preview), moving testing from yearly to every change.
highlights.action: Pilot it on a non-critical repository and compare findings with your last external pentest.

highlights.why_it_matters: Private CA now logs every issued certificate in CloudTrail, including content, issuing CA and requester. Audit evidence for your PKI without manual collection.
highlights.action: Route these events to your audit trail and alert on unexpected issuers.

highlights.why_it_matters: You can restrict the Identity Store and SCIM APIs by source network, closing a path for changing users and groups from outside your network.
highlights.action: Allow only your identity provider and provisioning automation ranges.

cves.note: Code execution when importing a crafted agent, plus SSRF. Update the toolkit in dev and CI.
Masking can fail open in versions 3.6.0 to 3.34.0: sensitive fields may reach logs.

question: Are AI agent toolkits part of your patch process yet, or still outside it?
